Auto-Grab Gun: Automatically collects the dropped gun whenever it appears.
Walk Speed: Customize your character's movement speed.
Jump Power: Adjust how high your character jumps.
Infinite Jump: Jump endlessly without touching the ground.
Collect All Coins (Instant): Instantly teleports and collects every available coin.
TP to Nearest Coin: Teleports you to the closest collectible coin.
Fullbright: Removes darkness for maximum visibility.
No Fog: Eliminates fog for a clearer view of the map.
Camera FOV: Freely adjust your camera's field of view.
Hide Own Name: Hides your name locally for a cleaner screen.
Anti-AFK (Never Kicked): Prevents idle kicks while you're away.
Anti-Slip (Lock Y Axis on Ice): Prevents slipping on icy surfaces.
Rejoin Server: Quickly reconnect to your current server.
Auto-Shoot Murderer: Automatically fires at the murderer when they're in range.
Silent Aim (Redirect Shots): Redirects your shots toward the intended target without precise aiming.
Auto-Grab Knife: Automatically collects the murderer's dropped knife.
No Clip: Walk through walls, doors, and other obstacles.
Fly Speed: Adjust your flight speed with a customizable slider.
Fly (WASD + Space/Ctrl): Smooth directional flight with full keyboard controls.
Teleport to Murderer: Instantly teleport to the current murderer.
Teleport to Sheriff: Instantly teleport to the current sheriff.
ESP: Murderer: Highlights the murderer's location through walls.
ESP: Sheriff: Highlights the sheriff's location through walls.
ESP: Gun Drop: Shows the location of the dropped gun at all times.
ESP: Knife Drop: Displays the location of dropped knives through walls.
Auto-Collect Coins (Loop): Continuously collects coins as they spawn.
ESP: Innocents: Highlights all innocent players through walls.
Anti-Fling / Anti-Void: Protects against fling exploits and falling into the void.
Server Hop: Instantly join a different public server.
